description: This Java source file defines the utility class CoapErrorResponse, which provides static methods for handling error responses in a CoAP (Constrained Application Protocol) context. It includes methods to determine if an error is temporary, convert exceptions to appropriate CoAP response codes, and send error responses over a CoapExchange object.

classes.name: CoapErrorResponse
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for generating and sending error responses in CoAP protocol interactions.

methods.name: isTemporaryError
methods.description: Checks whether the provided Throwable indicates a transient error that the client may retry.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Overloaded methods to send error responses over a CoapExchange, including converting a Throwable into a CoAP response.

methods.name: toCoapCode
methods.description: Maps a Throwable to an appropriate CoAP ResponseCode, using the error code from ServiceInvocationException if available.
